verdict.rationale: Fastmail ships an integrated Calendar feature with a dedicated help article on 'Calendar events and invitations,' indicating in-client calendar viewing and invite handling alongside email. However, evidence doesn't detail event creation UI specifics or provide independent/community corroboration of the calendar-in-email workflow. missing for 10: detailed documentation of creating events (not just invitations), independent/hands-on confirmation of calendar UX, coverage of RSVP/response flows.
